# Project Instructions

## Coding style
- Use simple, readable Python.
- Follow PEP 8 naming conventions.
- Prefer standard library modules when practical.
- Use descriptive names for variables and functions.
- Keep functions focused on one responsibility and use type hints.
- Add short docstrings to public functions when their purpose is not obvious.
- Follow existing project conventions.

## Code changes
- Make the smallest change that completes the requested task.
- Do not add new dependencies without asking.
- Ask for clarification when requirements are ambiguous.

## Task workflow
- Work on one task at a time.
- When finished, summarize the changes and any test results.
- Explain any remaining problems or limitations.
